vault-landing.title: The Rattling Lift
body: The vault lift coughs you into the undercity, a place where lanterns burn on borrowed hours.
Your coat smells of gun-oil and old incantations. The city expects payment in either.
vault-landing.outcome: A neon sigil hums to life, waiting for your first move.

choices.text: Inspect the arcane revolver etched to your hip.
choices.outcome: The cylinder clicks like a prayer answered.

choices.text: Meditate and refill your sigils.
choices.outcome: Your breath steadies; mana settles in your palms.

choices.text: Kick open the lift gate and stride into the dust.
choices.outcome: You leave a dent in the vault for the tax collectors.

gunner-oath.title: Gunner's Oath
body: The revolver is ancient tech: six chambers for six spells, each one hungry.
Its hum warms your fingers, eager for a target.
gunner-oath.outcome: You whisper the oath and the barrel answers back.

choices.text: Carve a warding rune into the barrel.
choices.outcome: The metal drinks the rune and shines with a pale current.

choices.text: Holster it and move on.
choices.outcome: A simple choice, but the city remembers every shortcut.

sigil-surge.title: Sigil Surge
body: You trace your powdered sigil in the air, drawing power from the street lamps.
Mana rushes like rainwater through a gutter.
sigil-surge.outcome: The magic settles, bright and obedient.

choices.text: Head into the alleyways.
choices.outcome: Your boots meet the grit of the undercity.

dust-alley.title: The Dust Alley
body: Steam coalesces into shapes that might be ghosts or debt collectors.
Three paths call to you: an apothecary, a clocktower, and the clatter of a rail bridge.

choices.text: Slip into the apothecary of glass and ash.
Climb toward the clocktower spire.
Follow the train whistle to the rattlebridge.

apothecary.title: Ash Apothecary
body: Shelves groan under vials that glow, hiss, and occasionally sing.
The apothecary squints at your gun and grins with a mouth of brass.

choices.text: Trade two gold for an ember tonic.
choices.outcome: The tonic burns down your throat, leaving warmth in its wake.

choices.text: Ask for rumors and pay with a smile.
choices.outcome: He points with a bone spoon. "Clocktower hides a storm key."

choices.text: Back to the alley.

rumors.title: The Brass Rumor
body: "Storm key wakes the bridge," he mutters. "But the tower bites."
You pocket the warning like a coin.

choices.text: Seek the clocktower.
Take your chances at the rattlebridge.

clocktower.title: Clocktower Throat
body: The gears hum a tune older than the city.
Static crawls along the iron rails leading upward.

choices.text: Wind the tower with your rune-etched charm.
choices.outcome: Your charm resonates, and the storm sleeps.

choices.text: Climb without warding.
choices.outcome: The tower bites. Lightning kisses your collar.

choices.text: Retreat to the alley.

storm-call.title: Storm Call
body: You find the storm key hanging inside a nest of copper filaments.
It is cold and loud, like a key that remembers every lock.
storm-call.outcome: The storm key thrums in your pocket.

choices.text: Take the storm key and descend.

shockfall.title: Shockfall
body: You land hard in a nest of sparking wires.
The tower laughs with thunder in your ears.
shockfall.outcome: Your hands shake, but you can still grip the revolver.

choices.text: Limp to the apothecary.
Crawl toward the rattlebridge.

rattlebridge.title: The Rattlebridge
body: The bridge shivers as the ghost train approaches.
A lock of stormlight bars the far exit. The train crew watches with hollow eyes.

choices.text: Use the storm key to silence the lock.
choices.outcome: The lock sings, then opens like a tired mouth.

choices.text: Burn mana to force the barrier.
choices.outcome: Your palms blaze, and the barrier splits.

choices.text: Stand your ground and duel the train crew.
choices.outcome: Their eyes shine brighter than your resolve.

finale-risk.title: Stormbound
body: The storm obeys, but the cost is steep. Your sigils dim to embers.
Only one move remains: bind the bridge or be bound to it.

choices.text: Spend the last of your mana to bind the bridge.
choices.outcome: You seal the bridge and claim the rail coin.

choices.text: Yield and step back into the shadows.

finale-win.title: Railborn Crown
body: The ghost train bows, rails cooling beneath your boots.
You pocket the stormlight and walk into the dawn with a new legend.

ending.label: Victory
ending.text: The undercity will remember the wizard who tamed the bridge.

finale-lose.title: Cold Rails
body: The bridge shuts, and the storm drags its fingers across your coat.
Some legends are warnings more than songs.

ending.label: Defeat
ending.text: The city sleeps, and your name slips back into myth.
